name: Noel
source: Forced to move back to her hometown of Hawthorn, Noel experiences heavy frustration and loneliness. She is convinced she is a burden to her [url=/c121269]sister[/url] and [url=/c121267]Elliot[/url], and is forced to begin unlearning the years of negativity she has internalized. However, she is also able to joke around and enjoy new holiday experiences, demonstrating that she is unwilling to let her unfortunate situation get the best of her.
